description: Use when the user provides a Feishu/Lark document URL (feishu.cn or larksuite.com) and wants to export, download, save, or convert it to a local Markdown file. Triggers on phrases like "Export Lark documents as Markdown, save them locally, or convert ", or any feishu.cn/docx link with export intent.
